title: Some Goodbyes We Made
description:
"Some Goodbyes We Made" is a minigame collection about saying goodbye. It consists of 11 short minigames, each preserving a precious farewell memory.

In this game, players will experience many different farewell stories, including moving houses, graduation ceremonies, quarrels with friends, and more. You'll see how the protagonist preserves the sadness and profundity of their goodbyes through these minigames, and feel the unique complexity, heartache, or beauty of each one.

The minigames in the collection include visual novels, platformers, and even character creators. In this one-hour experience, you might also revisit the goodbyes of your own life.
Here are some of games you'll get to play in Some Goodbyes We Made:
Bye Bye Bye Bye

Wave your mouse to say goodbye as a train takes you away.

The Graduation Performance

You are giving a vocal performance at your graduation ceremony. Choose between staying calm and focusing on your singing, or remembering the times here and releasing your emotion.

I Don't Want To Move

Play as a seven year old making trouble on moving day, and play with all your favorite things before your parents pack them into the car.
description_short: I have some memories of saying goodbye that I don't want to forget, so I turned them into 11 minigames and backed them up in this collection.
